rule: SHRINK-ONLY accessibility budget for the axe-core phase of the browser client tier (bun run test:client). required_surfaces: the named cataloguing surfaces the phase MUST mount (client/dedalo/test/client/js/a11y_surfaces.js) — a surface the run did not mount is RED, never silently skipped. The record surface is named THREE times because a component group NESTS and because the shipped columns render NO label node: a flat wrapper cannot show a portal row giving every column the portal's name, and a nested row built with label NODES is a DOM the application never renders — all 14 view_line_edit_* pass label:null, which is the shape component_line_row builds. The login form is named because it is the first surface a curator meets and its fields were labelled only by a placeholder. The dialog is named THREE times because its accessibility contract differs per STATE and per declared modality: open+modal isolates the page, minimized (parked in the strip) must not, and a remove_overlay panel never does. violations: one entry per (surface, axe rule id) with the node count still tolerated and the reason it is. A violation over its budget is red; an UNBUDGETED violation is red; and a budgeted violation that no longer fires is red too, so an excuse cannot outlive the defect it names. Judged in scripts/lib/client_gate_verdict.ts (judgeAxe) through the same exit as every other client-gate verdict; guarded by test/unit/client_a11y_budget_tripwire.test.ts.
